_comment: Conflict theaters tracked by World Pulse. 'names' are case-sensitive proper nouns matched in headlines/excerpts; 'pairs' match only when every name in the pair appears. 'spoken' is how the video voiceover says the name. lat/lon place the theater on the map. Descriptions stay neutral and timeless; the current situation comes from the hourly analysis.

theaters.name: Russia–Ukraine
theaters.description: War between Russia and Ukraine, including front-line fighting in the east and south, long-range strikes, and peace diplomacy.

theaters.name: Israel–Palestine
theaters.description: Conflict between Israel and Palestinian armed groups in Gaza and the West Bank, including the humanitarian situation and ceasefire efforts.

theaters.name: Israel–Lebanon
theaters.description: Hostilities between Israel and Hezbollah along the Israel–Lebanon border and inside Lebanon.

theaters.name: Iran & the Gulf
theaters.description: Military and nuclear tensions involving Iran, Israel, the United States and Gulf states.

theaters.name: Yemen & Red Sea
theaters.description: Yemen's civil war and Houthi attacks on shipping and on targets in the region, and the strikes made in response.

theaters.name: Syria
theaters.description: Security, transition and armed violence in Syria, including foreign strikes and sectarian clashes.

theaters.name: Sudan
theaters.description: War between the Sudanese Armed Forces and the Rapid Support Forces, and one of the world's largest humanitarian crises.

theaters.name: South Sudan
theaters.description: Political violence and armed clashes in South Sudan.

theaters.name: Eastern DR Congo
theaters.description: Fighting between Congolese forces, M23 and other armed groups in eastern DR Congo.

theaters.name: Sahel
theaters.description: Jihadist insurgencies and military governments across Mali, Burkina Faso and Niger.

theaters.name: Nigeria
theaters.description: Insurgent, bandit and communal violence in Nigeria.

theaters.spoken: Ethiopia and the Horn of Africa
theaters.name: Ethiopia & Horn
theaters.description: Armed conflict and regional tensions in Ethiopia, Eritrea and Somalia.

theaters.name: Myanmar
theaters.description: Civil war between Myanmar's military government and resistance and ethnic armed groups.

theaters.name: India–Pakistan
theaters.description: Tensions and clashes between India and Pakistan, including in Kashmir.

theaters.name: Afghanistan–Pakistan
theaters.description: Militancy and border clashes involving Pakistan, the Taliban government and armed groups.

theaters.spoken: the Taiwan Strait and the South China Sea
theaters.name: Taiwan Strait & South China Sea
theaters.description: Military pressure and maritime confrontations around Taiwan and in the South China Sea.

theaters.name: Korean Peninsula
theaters.description: North Korea's weapons programmes and military tensions on the Korean peninsula.

theaters.name: Haiti
theaters.description: Gang violence, displacement and the security mission in Haiti.

theaters.name: Venezuela & Caribbean
theaters.description: Military tensions involving Venezuela and operations in the Caribbean.
